repeatability.scope: Repeatability of observed game demand; not demand-standardized ability or prediction gain

observed_onset_plus_zero_intercept_sqrt_.assumptions: Common constant acceleration after observed onset and negligible initial forward speed
Common constant acceleration after observed onset and negligible initial forward speed

arrival.selection_scope: Complete observed LOS crossings with post-snap onset; censored/noncrossing rushes are not imputed
arrival.model_scope: Conditional-on-crossing NFL timing. This does not establish Combine-to-NFL transfer or full pass-rush value.

predictive_state.protocol: Outer unseen player; train-player-only scaling and 3-fold rank/history/penalty selection
predictive_state.scope: Same-domain NFL finite-horizon movement forecast; no Combine transfer or scouting advantage established

source_manifest.provenance: Public repository posted by the dataset publisher; no repository LICENSE present. Raw input retained for analysis, not relicensed.

checkpoints.protocol_note: Trend and matched full-rank controls added after first inspection; fitted predictive-state protocol and outer held players were retained unchanged.
